name: io.github.hammasbuilds/pak-law-assistant
title: Pakistan law
description: Pakistani statutes by date: cited answers, citation audits, amendment history. No repealed law.

environmentVariables.name: PAKLAW_CORPUS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a statute corpus (JSON Lines) built with paklaw-corpus. Without it the server runs on a three-provision demonstration sample and says so in every result.

environmentVariables.name: PAKLAW_MIN_COVERAGE
environmentVariables.description: Share of a question's content words a provision must carry before it is offered, 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5; a large corpus wants a higher value.

environmentVariables.name: PAKLAW_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON Lines file to append one record per tool call to: the tool, how long it took and whether it refused. Never the question. Off unless set.
